title: Builder Pattern
concept: The Builder pattern separates object construction from representation — using a fluent API to build complex objects step by step with clear defaults.
why: When a struct has 10+ fields, constructors become unreadable. Builders make construction self-documenting with named methods and sensible defaults.
tips: Return &mut Self from builder methods to enable method chaining
Put all validation in build() — the builder accepts any values, build() validates
Use Default for the builder's initial state — DRY with sensible defaults
Consider a consuming build(self) if the builder shouldn't be reused after construction
common_mistakes: Not validating in build() — builders should catch invalid configurations before construction
Making build() mandatory when the user might want to use the builder directly
Builder methods that have side effects — builders should be pure configuration collectors
